sources.beginner: Gas-side values (density, actual rate, settling velocity, gas diameter, margin) need z, i.e. the Suite Separator & Slug Catcher Designer (src/components/separatorstudio/SeparatorPanels.jsx:121-263, fmt 1 to 3 decimals) against a four-decimal prompt; height is a taught hand calc. NextGen panels are select-only.
sources.intermediate: Liquid length, both slug layouts and both setbacks are taught closed forms; gas velocity needs z (studio fmt 3) and its tol 1e-5 is below the prompt's four decimals.
sources.advanced: Interface (bisection), droplet times (Stokes) by hand; the family preference needs z (studio sweep fmt 1); the ADANGA layout rankings cannot be computed because the prompt gives no item coordinates and no Suite layout exists.

fields.evidence: Working volume (620 bbl + 19800 bpd over 8 min) over the 0.65 fill, then V = pi/4 D^2 x 5D solved for D in closed form (m04/l02-l03).

fields.prompt_precision: "Lengths in ft, velocities in ft/s and distances in m, to four decimals."

fields.prompt_precision: "Lengths in ft, velocities in ft/s and distances in m, to four decimals."
fields.evidence: Point source: d = sqrt(F tau Q / (4 pi I)) with Q = 27 x 47500 kW: 65.5919 m; closed form from prompt inputs.

fields.prompt_precision: "Lengths in ft, velocities in ft/s and distances in m, to four decimals."
fields.evidence: Pool area x burning rate x heat of combustion gives Q, the point-source radius follows, minus the 12 m pool radius (l04:9-15): 69.6531 - 12 = 57.6531 m.

fields.prompt_precision: "Lengths in ft, times in s, distances in m and the fraction as a fraction, to four decimals or better."
fields.recommendation: Widen to 5e-5 (half a unit at the four decimals the prompt asks for); tightening is not involved. Also print the studio interface at 6 decimals (src/components/separatorstudio/SeparatorPanels.jsx:244 fmt 2) for learners who use it.
fields.evidence: Water share from the two retentions, then the depth whose segment area matches, found by bisection as l02:11 describes (a spreadsheet goal seek); no z. But at the prompt's four decimals 3.5273 misses tol 1e-5 by 2.0e-5, so a learner who follows the instruction fails.
fields.notes: "or better" in the prompt does not tell the learner that five decimals are required.

fields.prompt_precision: "Lengths in ft, times in s, distances in m and the fraction as a fraction, to four decimals or better."
fields.evidence: Stokes velocity from the stated densities, viscosity and 350 micron drop (m02/l01) over the oil layer height (level minus interface); full precision once the interface is solved; tol 0.001 s.
fields.notes: Suite prints the fall time fmt(...,0) s (src/components/separatorstudio/SeparatorPanels.jsx:250).

fix.redesign: Keep the key; state the yard in the prompt as north/east offsets in m from the datum 4.9021 N, 6.8714 E for the ten items (Wellhead A 0,0 ... Yard control room 245,185; Second slop tank no coordinates), or seed an ADANGA layout the learner opens in the Facility Layout Mapper, and print the shortfall at 4 decimals (SpacingPanel.jsx:173 fmt 1)

fields.recommendation: Ungradable as posed: the item positions exist only in capstone-only code (separationLab.js:1359-1370, guarded from panels) and no Suite project named ADANGA exists (grep of Suite src/ and supabase/). Add the coordinates to the prompt (a haversine or flat-offset hand calc then works, intermediate/m05/l02) and fix the Layout Mapper precision.
fields.evidence: Prompt gives only the two setbacks and "a portable flare that was never placed and a second slop tank carrying no coordinates"; no coordinates for any item. Facility Layout Mapper prints `short {fmt(result.worstAbsolute.shortfallM, 1)} m`.
